thread:
Asha: heads up - dashboards are pegging main-thread and several charts hang on initial paint after the 09:30 routing rollout. saw this in RUM and a few customer reports.
Tom: yep, noticed increased JS parse + many failed XHRs to /api/tiles. RUM shows LCP jump ~1.2s and TTFB for tile requests is spiky.
Jae: looks like the routing pool shuffle changed which origin serves tiles; our CDN signed-URL includes a pool token so clients are getting different object keys -> edge misses + origin revalidates.
Riley: deploy log: infra-bot deployed routing-pools v11 at 09:28 (pool-balancer: enable_lazy_failover=true). infra-bot: deploy 6820009500 finished by Jae at 09:28:12 UTC
Asha: example client log: `fetch /tiles/heat/12/34/56 502 then retry 200` and stack traces show repeated re-fetches for the same chunk.
Tom: server logs snippet:
```
[09:30:10] WARN pool-switch: route=/api/tiles from=eu-pool to=us-pool reason=capacity_low
[09:30:11] INFO cdn: signed-url key=tiles/heat/12/34/56 pool=us-pool cache_status=MISS
[09:30:12] ERROR frontend: paint-blocked component=HeatmapTile load=1210ms
```
Jae: theory: lazy_failover changed pool mapping dynamically, causing some clients mid-session to get different pool tokens. That invalidates cached asset keys and busts kvcache affinity for rendered tiles.
Riley: mitigation options: (1) rollback lazy_failover flag (fast), (2) add a session-affinity cookie to keep pool token stable (needs auth tweak), (3) make signed URLs independent of pool token (longer).
Asha: for immediate fix, rollback + temporary increase origin edge TTL to reduce revalidates. Also publish short status note on Slack support channel.
Tom: agree. I'll keep an eye on RUM while we rollback. Also add a telemetry field `pool_hint` to tile requests so traces show pool transitions. Small change and helpful for follow-ups.
infra-bot: rolling back deploy 6820009500 -> intent=rollback_by_Jae initiated at 09:34:05 UTC
Jae: rollback done 09:36:20 UTC. early metrics trending down but leaving edge TTL bump for 15m.
Asha: next steps: Jae -> RFC to decouple signed URL from runtime pool + timeline; Tom -> quick telemetry change to log `pool_hint`; Riley -> prototype session cookie toggle for affinity; I'll coordinate a small canary with lazy_failover off until we have tests. ETA: sync at noon.
Riley: filed follow-up INF-2401: signed-url pool coupling and session-affinity experiment.
Asha: thanks team. keeping this open for 1h to confirm no regressions, then close. :white_check_mark:
